evidence.detail: rs/a/m extends R30 Renderable and its c() method resolves an ObjectDefinition, advances an optional Sequence frame from Client.ff timing, and returns the definition-built Model for the stored object type/orientation/tile-height state.

R53 ObjectManager constructs rs/a/m whenever a placed object definition has an animation id or morph/child-definition table; otherwise it builds the static Model directly. This is the exact static-vs-dynamic scene-object split.

Client runtime object-animation handling wraps existing wall, wall-decoration, game-object and floor-decoration scene entries in new rs/a/m instances, preserving object id/type/orientation while supplying the requested animation id.

The constructor optionally accepts a prior Renderable; when that prior object is another rs/a/m using the same Sequence and restart mode allows continuity, it copies the prior animation frame/tick state instead of restarting.

proposals.note: DynamicObject is the conservative exact-v308 name for the Renderable scene object that resolves object-definition morphs and/or advances object animation sequences at render time.
